summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I filed an 8-K regarding entry into an Intercreditor Agreement among Melar, Agile Capital Funding, Agile Lending, YA II PN, and Everli Global. The agreement subordinates Agile Parties' debt to Melar Lender and YA Lender as senior creditors. It is a routine intercreditor arrangement among existing lenders and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change. No deal terms are present; this is a standard debt subordination agreement.
